evals.prompt: Generate the React JSX component files for the invoices editor. The master config is at playground/gs-billing-app/config_dbdef/frontend/invoices.json and it has a child component InvoiceLines whose config is at playground/gs-billing-app/config_dbdef/frontend/invoice_lines.json. Use 'BillingMenu' as the menu group folder. Output to playground/jsx-code-builder-test/eval-1/
evals.expected_output: Two JSX files: Invoices.jsx (master) and InvoiceLines.jsx (child), plus integration snippets for App.jsx, menu, and endpoints
expectations: Creates a file named Invoices.jsx in the BillingMenu directory
Creates a file named InvoiceLines.jsx in the BillingMenu directory
Invoices.jsx imports from 'genericsuite' and the invoices.json config
Invoices.jsx imports InvoiceLines from './InvoiceLines.jsx'
Invoices.jsx exports Invoices_EditorData function that calls GetFormData with the config, registry, and 'Invoices_EditorData' string
Invoices.jsx registry includes 'Invoices' and 'InvoiceLines' entries
Invoices.jsx exports Invoices component wrapping GenericCrudEditor
InvoiceLines.jsx exports component receiving {parentData, handleFormPageActions} props
InvoiceLines.jsx calls GetFormData with false as third argument
InvoiceLines.jsx passes parentData and handleFormPageActions to GenericCrudEditor
Outputs App.jsx integration snippet with componentMap entries for both Invoices and InvoiceLines
Outputs app_main_menu.json snippet with element 'Invoices_EditorData'
Outputs endpoints.json snippet for invoices and invoice_lines (since child is subType table)

evals.prompt: Generate React JSX components for the customers editor. The config is at playground/gs-billing-app/config_dbdef/frontend/customers.json. It has no child components. Use 'ContactsMenu' as the menu group. Output to playground/jsx-code-builder-test/eval-2/
evals.expected_output: One JSX file: Customers.jsx (master with no children), plus integration snippets
expectations: Creates a file named Customers.jsx in the ContactsMenu directory
Does NOT create any child component JSX files
Customers.jsx imports from 'genericsuite' and the customers.json config
Customers.jsx does NOT import any child components
Customers.jsx exports Customers_EditorData function that calls GetFormData
Customers.jsx registry includes 'Customers' entry but no child entries
Customers.jsx exports Customers component wrapping GenericCrudEditor as arrow function with no props
Outputs App.jsx integration snippet with componentMap entry for Customers only
Outputs app_main_menu.json snippet with element 'Customers_EditorData'

evals.prompt: Generate React JSX components for the accounts editor. The config is at playground/gs-billing-app/config_dbdef/frontend/accounts.json. It has a select field with inline select_elements as an array of {title, value} objects (not a named constant). No child components. Use 'AccountingMenu' as the menu group. Output to playground/jsx-code-builder-test/eval-3/
evals.expected_output: One JSX file: Accounts.jsx with no constant imports needed (inline {title, value} select_elements), plus integration snippets
expectations: Creates a file named Accounts.jsx in the AccountingMenu directory
Accounts.jsx does NOT import from app_constants.jsx (the select_elements is an inline array of {title, value} objects, not a named constant)
Accounts.jsx exports Accounts_EditorData function that calls GetFormData
Accounts.jsx registry includes 'Accounts' entry
Accounts.jsx exports Accounts component wrapping GenericCrudEditor
Does NOT create any child component JSX files
Outputs App.jsx integration snippet with componentMap entry for Accounts

Validates select_elements shape: a string constant name or an array of {title, value} objects is accepted; an array of bare strings is flagged as invalid (would render broken select options at runtime) instead of generating silently
